hooks: Staring into a half-empty fridge wondering what to cook tonight?
How much food in your fridge ends up getting thrown away?
Tired of wasting groceries because you don't know what to make?
hook_card_prompt: Minimalist green title card with 'PantryPal' in bold modern white typography surrounded by subtle fresh grocery icons.

problem.voice_line: People waste food and time because they do not know what to cook with what they already have.

demos.voice_line: Take a photo of your open fridge to detect ingredients.

claims.text: Take a photo of your open fridge to detect ingredients.

demos.voice_line: It suggests three recipes ranked by how many of your ingredients they use.

claims.text: suggests three recipes ranked by how many of your ingredients they use

how.voice_line: Vision processing identifies ingredients from the photo, while recipe matching calculates which dishes maximize what you have.

impact.voice_line: Cook what you already have and keep good food out of the trash.
